consumer: The interactive NPC trade menu reached via npc_menu's 'Talk' -> start_trade (the trade UI loop), which asks the player to select which items to give and take and to confirm the exchange at the offered prices.
scope: The interactive give/take exchange between the player's own inventory and the shopkeeper NPC's inventory, driven through the real input loop and confirmed via the trade menu (not just the avatar's carried items or nearby ground items).
decisive_source: The decisive routine (the trade menu/loop, e.g. trade_ui / talk_function::start_trade) is NOT shown in the excerpts; src/game.cpp::npc_menu only builds a uilist and queries 'Talk', which dispatches into the dialogue/trade system, while arcopolis_export.cpp::write_carried_items and write_entities merely serialize raw item state (S) and are display/state surfaces, not the load-bearing trade authority.
divergence: A snapshot where the avatar's carried_items gains the bought item and the shopkeeper's stock decreases (or cash changes) without the interactive trade menu ever being driven through the input loop -- the exchange 'completed' with no select/price/confirm step, a false-success no-op a class-B authority would expose.
